title: Starting stopping dashboard
notes: 40 fact cards, all Tier 1, sourced from a direct full-text read (via r.jina.ai per ADAPT-2) of the actual 282-page 2008 Fit Owner's Manual PDF at techinfo.honda.com (S-001), cross-checked word for word against two independent mirrors of the same manual (S-021 hfitinfo.com, S-022 manualslib.com; both added as new Source Cards). Full warning-light table (24 named indicators in the manual; 5 excluded from the base-trim table as Sport-only/Canada-only: fog light, security system, cruise main, cruise control, DRL, washer level -- base US Fit has none of these per WP-01 F-WP01-027). Confirmed clutch-pedal-down requirement (manual) and shift-lever-in-Park-plus-brake (automatic) for START to function; confirmed low fuel light = 1.7 US gal remaining; confirmed base automatic gear set is P-R-N-D-D3-2-1 (no S, no paddle shifters); confirmed gauge cluster = speedometer, tachometer, fuel gauge, odometer, trip meter A/B, information display (no separate coolant temp gauge, light-only); documented full shift lock release procedure and location. 1 fact UNVERIFIED (F-WP04-036, normal idle RPM -- not stated anywhere in the manual; redline 6,500 rpm cross-referenced from WP-01 instead). No conflicts found this pass (all three sources agreed verbatim); none logged to queue/conflicts.md.

title: Driving
notes: 16 fact cards, all sourced to a direct curl read (not a search snippet) of the hfitinfo.com mirror of the Honda Fit 2001-2008 first-generation owner's manual (Tier 1) plus fueleconomy.gov EPA driving tips (Tier 2). Confirmed the base (non-Sport) automatic HAS a full P-R-N-D-D3-2-1 gate (text + labeled shift-gate diagram), contrary to the plan's caution that some Fit automatics might only have D and one lower gear; Sport model instead has P-R-N-D-S with paddle shifters. Confirmed manual shift pattern, 5th-to-reverse lockout mechanism, recommended shift-point speeds (15/27/39/53 mph), 600-mile/1,000 km break-in period with its specific dos/don'ts, owner's-manual and EPA fuel economy tips, snow-tire and tire-chain guidance (chains: front only, SAE Class S cable-type, no metal link chains), and trailer towing (manual states the car is not designed to tow a trailer at all and doing so can void the warranty -- no numeric rating given). 1 fact (F-WP06-009, hill start method) left UNVERIFIED as a Honda-documented feature/procedure -- confirmed absent from the manual's full Driving chapter table of contents; this generation predates Hill Start Assist. Procedure cards WP-06-1 (hill start) and WP-06-2 (first manual drive) use a general three-pedal technique grounded in this vehicle's own documented clutch/parking-brake behavior, explicitly flagged as general technique rather than a Honda-published Fit procedure. No conflicts found this pass (single coherent primary source); none logged to queue/conflicts.md.

title: Roadside emergencies
notes: 32 fact cards, all Tier 1 (S-001), sourced from a full direct read of the actual 2008 Fit Owner's Manual PDF (techinfo.honda.com/rjanisis/pubs/om/AAA080/AAA0808OM.pdf) via the r.jina.ai proxy per ADAPT-2 -- upgrades S-001 from search-snippet-only to directly-verified; sources/S-001.md updated accordingly. Compact spare (60 psi, 50 mph limit) confirmed for base trim, no full-size/no-spare variant found. Only the Brake System Indicator is explicitly labeled red in the manual text; low oil pressure and charging system indicators are red per 2 independent Tier 4 dealer-blog sources each (medium confidence on color only); malfunction indicator lamp color left UNVERIFIED. No warning triangle/reflector/flare mentioned anywhere in the 282-page manual (1 fact, F-WP07-024, left UNVERIFIED as a result). Flat-tow finding: the manual does NOT support all-4-wheels-down long-distance flat towing for either transmission -- only flatbed or front-wheel-lift are normal methods; a front-wheels-on-ground contingency exists only for damage cases, capped at 50 mi/35 mph, with different prep steps per transmission (manual: neutral + ACC; automatic: D-hold-5-sec then N then 3-min idle + ACC). 3 procedure cards written (flat tire, jump start, overheating), all steps under 25 words, safety warnings before steps. No new conflicts found (0 logged to queue/conflicts.md this pass).
